version_scope: Marketing/capability framing changes over time — attach dated SAP sources before VERIFIED

claims.text: Do not treat a fixed five-pillar inventory (for example Database, Application Development, Integration, Analytics, IAM) as current authoritative BTP architecture unless a dated SAP source for the interview context is verified.

For security-focused BTP questions prefer: global account/directory/subaccount structure, IAS trust, role templates, role collections, XSUAA (Authorization and Trust Management), destinations/connectivity including Cloud Connector, audit logging. Do not omit AI or other current platform themes solely because an older pillar list omitted them — and do not invent members.

Excluded look-alike error: answering BTP pillars as if IAM were a timeless fifth pillar while omitting current topics the question expects, or delivering a numbered markdown list that truncates mid-sentence.

sources.section: SAP BTP product overview / security — verify dated framing
